start: A folder with routines on the Workout tab

steps.action: Open the folder menu, tap share
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Share <folder>' with 'Text anyone can read, or a file another MettleUp member can open.'
'Send as text' and 'Send as a file'
must_not: Only one routine shared when the whole folder was picked

user_sees: Message with the folder name, each routine as '<name> · <day type>' and lines '1. <exercise> — 3 × 8–12'
must_not: Weights, body weight, notes about the member or history in the text
The old name 'ForgeAI' in the text

start: Share sheet open for one routine

user_sees: The phone's share menu titled 'Share routine' with a .json file
must_not: The member's workout history inside the file

start: Find a plan screen, a routine file received from another member

steps.action: Tap 'Import a routine file' and pick the file
user_sees: 'Routines added' 'They are in a new folder on the Workout tab.' or with 'New in your library: <names>.'
Back on the Workout tab with the new folder open
must_not: The member's followed plan changed by the import
Exercises with the same name added twice to the library

start: Member of a gym whose trainer made a workout plan (or set a workout of the day)

steps.action: Open the Workout tab after the gym's plans arrive
user_sees: A folder with the plan's routines and 'From <gym> · <trainer>'
must_not: A broken folder from a damaged plan (it must be skipped)

steps.action: The gym stops sending the plan
user_sees: 'No longer sent by <gym>' under the folder
must_not: The folder and the member's workouts deleted without a word

steps.action: Import a photo picked by mistake
user_sees: 'Could not open that file' 'That file is too big to be a routine file.' or 'That file is not a routine file.'
must_not: The photo read whole into memory

steps.action: Import a file from a newer app
user_sees: 'That file comes from a newer MettleUp. Update the app, then try again.'

steps.action: Import a file with no routines or a damaged routine
user_sees: 'That file has no routines in it.' or 'A routine in that file is damaged.'

steps.action: Tap 'Send as a file' on a phone with no app to send with
user_sees: 'Sharing is not available' 'This phone has no app to send the file with.'

start: The same routine file imported before

user_sees: Sheet 'You have this file already' 'It is in "<folder>".' with 'Update the existing folder' and 'Add a copy'
must_not: A second folder made without asking

user_sees: 'Folder updated' with 'Your changes were kept in: <routines>.' when the member edited them
Only routine names, exercises, sets, reps, rest, supersets and exercise notes
must_not: The member's name, weights lifted, body weight or gym in the shared text or file
